# Airgain Introduces Airgain RF Intelligence, an AI-Powered Platform to Accelerate Antenna Design


November 05, 2026 8:00am EST


*New AI-powered platform aims to simplify antenna selection and integration, expand Airgain's reach to more wireless device manufacturers, and unlock new market opportunities for its existing antenna portfolio.*


*Applications open for a selective early evaluation program, with initial customer access targeted for the first half of 2027.*


SAN DIEGO--(BUSINESS WIRE)-- Airgain, Inc. (NASDAQ: AIRG), a provider of advanced wireless connectivity solutions, today introduced Airgain RF Intelligence, a new AI-powered antenna engineering platform in development designed to make its RF expertise and extensive antenna portfolio more accessible to wireless device manufacturers and developers.


The platform aims to simplify antenna selection and integration for wireless applications, including compact IoT devices and other wireless products with relatively straightforward antenna requirements.


Starting with antenna selection and integration guidance, Airgain RF Intelligence is envisioned to evolve into a broader platform for AI-assisted RF engineering. Applications are now open for a selective early evaluation program, with initial customer access targeted for the first half of 2027.


Airgain RF Intelligence also targets original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and device developers whose production volumes have made custom antenna engineering difficult to justify financially. By providing AI-assisted guidance through a self-service platform, Airgain RF Intelligence aims to help these customers identify suitable antennas from Airgain's existing portfolio. This creates an opportunity to reach a broader customer base and generate incremental antenna sales while complementing Airgain's established custom-engineering business for more complex wireless systems.


**Leveraging Decades of Proven Antenna Engineering Expertise**


Airgain has more than two decades of experience designing and integrating antennas for major telecommunications and connected-device manufacturers, with a track record that includes shipping more than one billion antennas and developing thousands of unique antenna designs since its inception. Its experience supporting leading telecommunications and broadband providers, both domestically and internationally, spans demanding wireless applications, complex engineering requirements, and large-scale production programs.


Airgain RF Intelligence builds on this foundation, making antenna selection more accessible to developers whose applications do not require extensive custom engineering.


“Airgain has built its antenna expertise by helping major wireless equipment manufacturers solve complex design challenges,” **said Evan Jones, SVP of Engineering at Airgain.** “With Airgain RF Intelligence, we're looking to make that expertise accessible to a much broader customer base. By combining our existing antenna portfolio with AI-assisted engineering guidance, we believe we can simplify the design process, support customers we previously could not serve efficiently, and open new opportunities for our antenna business.”


**How Airgain RF Intelligence Works**


Airgain RF Intelligence is designed to use engineering rules and technical data to evaluate antenna options against radio specifications, physical constraints, and documented integration requirements. The platform is expected to provide AI-assisted recommendations identifying which antennas may be suitable, along with relevant integration considerations, potential risks, and additional testing and certification requirements. Final antenna performance and compliance remain subject to device-level validation.


**Early Evaluation Program Opens for Applications**


Airgain is inviting qualified OEMs, wireless device developers, and ecosystem partners to apply for its **Airgain RF Intelligence Early Evaluation Program** .


Selected participants will help evaluate the platform and provide feedback to guide future development. Initial customer access is targeted for the first half of 2027, subject to development and testing.


Airgain RF Intelligence is not yet generally available. Interested organizations can apply at:


[https://www.airgain.com/airgain-rf-intelligence/](https://airgain.com/airgain-rf-intelligence/)
